sar.narrative: Customer C13487 reported that they did not authorize the transactions associated with card C13487-K1 and confirmed they still possess the physical card. The suspicious activity occurred on 2016-11-22 via the online channel, involving transaction T3478561 from a device new to the account. The device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 was identified as the source of the unauthorized charges. Graph community detection linked this device to a shared cluster involving cards C01289-K2, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C06710-K1, C08168-K1, C09049-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K2, C10193-K2, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C12796-K1, and C13291-K1. This pattern is consistent with card-not-present fraud, resulting in a total identified exposure of $74.96. Case HHG-014 was opened to investigate the activity, which initially presented a fraud probability of 0.61 based on the new device usage. The customer's explicit denial of the purchases elevated the fraud probability to 0.84, confirming the likelihood of unauthorized access. Prior investigations CC-0078, CC-0247, CC-0178, CC-0815, and CC-0488 were reviewed as case memory to contextualize the shared device profile. The card C13487-K1 was blocked, and a report was filed to document the suspected fraud. Connected cards are now under monitoring to detect further unauthorized activity from the same device cluster.
